0.long_answer: Naproxen is the NSAID commonly used for inflammatory conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis and is recommended for relieving fever and joint swelling in individuals with Chikungunya. It works by reducing inflammation, pain, and fever, thereby helping to alleviate the symptoms associated with the viral infection. In the treatment context of Chikungunya, naproxen helps manage the acute phase symptoms as well as some of the chronic joint pain that can persist after the infection.
